# Meld Studio triggers

## Any Meld change (advanced)

Runs when anything in your Meld Studio session changes, like a layer, effect or audio track. For advanced users; the other Meld triggers are simpler.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Event** | Which kind of change to react to. Pick Any to react to every change. Options: Any, LayerVisibilityChanged, EffectEnabledStateChanged, TrackMutedStateChanged, TrackMonitoringStateChanged, ObjectAdded, ObjectUpdated, ObjectRemoved, SceneStaged, TrackGainChanged. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.name%` | The name of the Meld Studio connection |
| `%meldStudio.host%` | The computer Meld Studio runs on |
| `%meldStudioEvent.event%` | The kind of change, like LayerVisibilityChanged |
| `%meldStudioEvent._json%` | All details of the change as raw text |
| `%meldStudioEvent.layerName%` | The layer that changed (for layer changes) |
| `%meldStudioEvent.trackName%` | The audio track that changed (for track changes) |
| `%meldStudioEvent.effectName%` | The effect that changed (for effect changes) |
| `%meldStudioEvent.sceneName%` | The scene involved, if any |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.event`</small>

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to Meld Studio.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.name%` | The name of the Meld Studio connection |
| `%meldStudio.host%` | The computer Meld Studio runs on |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses its connection to Meld Studio, for example when you close it.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.name%` | The name of the Meld Studio connection |
| `%meldStudio.host%` | The computer Meld Studio runs on |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.disconnected`</small>

## Effect enabled state changed

Runs when an effect on a layer is switched on or off in Meld.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Effects** | Only react to these effects, typed as Meld shows them. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any effect. |
| **State** | Pick Enabled to react when it turns on, Disabled when it turns off, or Any for both. Options: Any, Enabled, Disabled. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.name%` | The name of the Meld Studio connection |
| `%meldStudio.host%` | The computer Meld Studio runs on |
| `%meldStudioEvent.effectName%` | The name of the effect |
| `%meldStudioEvent.enabled%` | True when the effect is now on |
| `%meldStudioEvent.layerName%` | The layer the effect is on |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.effectEnabledStateChanged`</small>

## Layer visibility changed

Runs when a layer (like a camera or image) is shown or hidden in a Meld scene.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Layers** | Only react to these layers (the things inside a scene, like a camera or image), typed as Meld shows them. Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any layer. |
| **State** | Pick Visible to react when a layer appears, Hidden when it disappears, or Any for both. Options: Any, Visible, Hidden. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.name%` | The name of the Meld Studio connection |
| `%meldStudio.host%` | The computer Meld Studio runs on |
| `%meldStudioEvent.layerName%` | The name of the layer |
| `%meldStudioEvent.layerId%` | Meld's id for the layer |
| `%meldStudioEvent.visible%` | True when the layer is now shown |
| `%meldStudioEvent.sceneName%` | The scene the layer is in |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.layerVisibilityChanged`</small>

## Scene changed

Runs when Meld Studio switches to another scene on the live output.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scenes** | Only react to these scenes, typed as Meld Studio shows them, like "Just Chatting". Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any scene. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.name%` | The name of the Meld Studio connection |
| `%meldStudio.host%` | The computer Meld Studio runs on |
| `%meldStudio.sceneName%` | The scene Meld switched to |
| `%meldStudio.sceneId%` | Meld's id for that scene |
| `%meldStudio.oldSceneName%` | The scene before the switch |
| `%meldStudio.oldSceneId%` | Meld's id for the old scene |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.sceneChanged`</small>

## Scene staged

Runs when you stage a scene in Meld (put it in the "up next" spot before showing it).

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Scenes** | Only react to these scenes, typed as Meld Studio shows them, like "Just Chatting". Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any scene. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.name%` | The name of the Meld Studio connection |
| `%meldStudio.host%` | The computer Meld Studio runs on |
| `%meldStudioEvent.sceneName%` | The scene that was staged |
| `%meldStudioEvent.sceneId%` | Meld's id for the scene |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.sceneStaged`</small>

## Track gain changed

Runs when the volume of an audio track changes in Meld.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Tracks** | Only react to these audio tracks, typed as Meld shows them (a layer name works for that layer's sound). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any track. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.name%` | The name of the Meld Studio connection |
| `%meldStudio.host%` | The computer Meld Studio runs on |
| `%meldStudioEvent.trackName%` | The name of the audio track |
| `%meldStudioEvent.gain%` | The new volume, from 0 (silent) to 1 (full) |
| `%meldStudioEvent.muted%` | True if the track is muted |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.trackGainChanged`</small>

## Track monitoring state changed

Runs when you start or stop listening to an audio track through your headphones (monitoring) in Meld.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Tracks** | Only react to these audio tracks, typed as Meld shows them (a layer name works for that layer's sound). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any track. |
| **State** | Pick Monitoring to react when listening starts, Not monitoring when it stops, or Any for both. Options: Any, Monitoring, Not monitoring. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.name%` | The name of the Meld Studio connection |
| `%meldStudio.host%` | The computer Meld Studio runs on |
| `%meldStudioEvent.trackName%` | The name of the audio track |
| `%meldStudioEvent.monitoring%` | True when you are now listening to it |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.trackMonitoringStateChanged`</small>

## Track muted state changed

Runs when an audio track is muted or unmuted in Meld.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Tracks** | Only react to these audio tracks, typed as Meld shows them (a layer name works for that layer's sound). Separate several with commas. Leave empty for any track. |
| **State** | Pick Muted to react when it is muted, Not muted when it is unmuted, or Any for both. Options: Any, Muted, Not muted. Starts as: `Any`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%meldStudio.name%` | The name of the Meld Studio connection |
| `%meldStudio.host%` | The computer Meld Studio runs on |
| `%meldStudioEvent.trackName%` | The name of the audio track |
| `%meldStudioEvent.muted%` | True when the track is now muted |

<small>Type id: `meldstudio.trackMutedStateChanged`</small>
